name: Chiaki Yumeno
source:
Meet Chiaki, who constantly experiments with his style in the creative arts. However, if there's one thing he's already skilled at. It's getting caught up in quite colorful messes!

Chiaki isn't afraid to be a tease and poke a little fun at everyone he meets, and he's always ready to add a little color around him no matter where he goes!
